She is first seen with [[Celosia]] and one of the {{tc|Team Flare Admin}}s at the [[Poké Ball Factory]], trying to coerce the company president into working for them. At the factory, the {{player}} and {{ga|Calem}} or {{ga|Serena}} will fight against Bryony and Celosia in a [[Multi Battle]]. She is met again at [[Lysandre Labs]], preparing for Team Flare's plan to use the [[ultimate weapon]]. ===Pokémon=== ===={{g|X and Y}}==== =====First battle ([[Multi Battle]] with [[Celosia]])===== {{color2|000|Pokémon X and Y|X and Y}} |} ==In animation== [[File:Bryony anime.png|thumb|200px|Bryony in {{aniseries|XY}}]] ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ====History==== In the past, Bryony, alongside [[Lysandre]] and the other [[Team Flare]] Scientists, would help those in need, until Lysandre became disillusioned with the [[human]] race and sought to restart the world. Bryony debuted in ''[[XY094|From A to Z!]]'', where [[Xerosic]] sent her to retrieve the {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Zygarde Core}} that had [[XYS04|escaped]] from [[Lysandre Labs]]. She was later seen cornering [[Squishy|the Core]], but the Core managed to summon its nearby {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Cells}}, allowing it to transform into its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|10% Forme}} and counterattack, forcing Bryony and her assistant {{tc|Team Flare Grunt|Grunts}} to retreat. She was later seen informing [[Celosia]] of what had happened. [[File:Team Flare Scientists Young.png|thumb|left|250px|A younger Bryony (left)]] In ''[[XY102|Meeting at Terminus Cave!]]'', Bryony teamed up with Celosia to retrieve Squishy in [[Terminus Cave]]. After a prolonged struggle, during which {{TRT}} interfered as well, Team Flare was forced to retreat, as they were unable to defeat [[Ash's Greninja]] and Squishy had fled. In [[XY103|the next episode]], she, along with Celosia and several Grunts, monitored sensors to find Squishy. Bryony and Celosia also ordered two Grunts to watch {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. Later, the sensors caught energy waves coming from Squishy and [[Z2]] and managed to determine Squishy's location. They, however, were unable to make it in time and lost sight of Squishy, as it had stopped emitting energy waves. Bryony and Celosia then ordered the pursuit squad to withdraw, as they thought Squishy probably wouldn't return to Ash and his friends, and decided to narrow their search. In ''[[XY132|A Towering Takeover!]]'', during Team Flare's attack on [[Lumiose City]], Bryony was guarding the [[Prism Tower]] with [[Aliana]]. In [[XY133|the following episode]], she and Bryony battled against some of {{an|Clemont}}'s Pokémon and [[Meyer|Blaziken Mask]]'s {{p|Blaziken}}, but both ended up getting defeated and were captured by [[Clembot]], allowing Clemont and Clembot to enter the Prism Tower. ====Pokémon==== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Bryony |pkmn=Bisharp |type1=Dark |type2=Steel |img=Bryony Bisharp.png |epnum=XY094 |epname=From A to Z! |vaen=Justin Anselmi |desc={{p|Bisharp}} first appeared in ''[[XY094|From A to Z!]]'', where it was used by Bryony whilst attempting to retrieve the {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Zygarde Core}} after it had escaped, but got defeated after [[Squishy|the Core]] transformed to its 10% Form. It reappeared in ''[[XY102|Meeting at Terminus Cave!]]'', where Bisharp was used to battle {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. It attacked [[Ash's Noibat]] with Iron Head, after it gained the upper hand against [[Celosia]]'s {{p|Drapion}}, and managed to stun the group's Pokémon with Metal Sound. Bisharp was eventually defeated by Squishy again, after it transformed to its 10% Form. Bisharp's known moves are {{m|Iron Head}}, {{m|Metal Sound}}, and {{m|Stone Edge}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Bryony |pkmn=Liepard |type1=Dark |img=Bryony Liepard.png |epnum=XY102 |epname=Meeting at Terminus Cave! |vaen=Erica Schroeder |desc={{p|Liepard}} debuted in ''[[XY102|Meeting at Terminus Cave!]]'', where it was sent out to pursue [[Squishy]], alongside [[Celosia]]'s {{p|Manectric}}. It was stopped in its tracks by [[Ash's Pikachu]] and {{AP|Greninja}}. Together with Manectric, they managed to damage Greninja, but when Greninja transformed to its Ash-Greninja Form, it was easily overpowered and beaten back. Liepard reappeared in ''[[XY133|Coming Apart at the Dreams!]]'', during [[Team Flare]]'s attack on [[Lumiose City]]. It was sent out to battle {{an|Clemont}}, [[Clembot]], and [[Meyer|Blaziken Mask]]'s Pokémon, alongside [[Aliana]]'s {{p|Druddigon}}, but was eventually defeated. Liepard's known move are {{m|Shadow Claw}} and {{m|Dark Pulse}}.}} ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{fire color light}}|bordercolor={{fire color dark}} |ja=藤田茜 ''[[Akane Fujita]]'' |en=[[Emily Woo Zeller]] |fr_eu=Helena Coppejans |pl=Anna Wodzyńska |pt_br=Fernanda Crispim |es_eu=Tania Ugía |es_la=Marisol Romero}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Team Flare Scientists Adventures.png|thumb|300px|Bryony in Pokémon Adventures]] Bryony debuted in ''[[PS550|X-actly What They Wanted]]''. She, [[Celosia]], and [[Xerosic]] were first seen watching the destruction of [[Vaniville Town]] caused by the battle between {{p|Xerneas}} and {{p|Yveltal}}. In ''[[PS555|The Aegislash Agenda]]'', Bryony and Xerosic met with [[Mable]] and [[Aliana]] at the [[Team Flare Secret HQ]]. Bryony informed the pair that their repeated failures have led to [[Celosia]] taking over their duties. In ''[[PS578|Gyarados Changes]]'', Bryony and the other female scientists witnessed {{adv|X}} trying to break into the Secret HQ. Noting Celosia's continued usage of her {{p|Aegislash}} caused her to start losing control of herself, Bryony knocked Celosia unconscious, took over her duties, and had Mable and Aliana return to their stations. She allowed X entry into the building, stating he'd regret his decision. Bryony then went outside waited for the [[ultimate weapon]] to be activated. In ''[[PS580|Flabébé Blooms]]'', {{adv|Y}} and the [[Kalos]] [[Gym Leader]]s worked to prevent the ultimate weapon from blooming by keeping the petals in place by force. Bryony tried to prevent {{adv|Trevor}}, {{adv|Tierno}}, and {{adv|Shauna}} from entering the Secret HQ via an incinerator chute, but they were saved by [[Clemont]]. Trevor's group made it to the ultimate weapon's control room, where they attempted to remove the device's key, but were unable to pull it out in time before it fired. Despite this, the combined efforts of X, his friends, and the Gym Leaders successfully weakened the ultimate weapon enough that it was unable to take any innocent lives. Bryony tried recapturing Xerneas, only to end up defeated when Xerneas joined Y's team instead. She was later helped by Aliana and Mable after [[Lysandre]] ordered a ceasefire between both sides. In ''[[PS589|Charizard Transforms]]'', the four female scientists each intercepted Y and her friends to prevent them from reaching the [[Pokémon Village]]. Bryony's opponent was Trevor, but the battle was interrupted when X used his [[Mega Evolution|Mega-Evolved]] [[Salamè]] to take out Bryony's {{p|Bisharp}}. Later, Bryony and Aliana teamed up to face both Trevor and Y, but the latter went ahead to help X at the Pokémon Village at Trevor's request. With the help of Y's [[Croaky]], Trevor eventually managed to take down Bryony with a {{m|Water Shuriken}}-{{m|Fairy Wind}} combination attack. ====Pokémon==== {{anchor|Liepard 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Bryony |pkmn=Liepard |type1=Dark |img=Bryony Liepard Adventures.png |epnum=PS550 |epname=X-actly What They Wanted |desc={{p|Liepard}} is Bryony's first known Pokémon. It was first seen watching {{p|Xerneas}} and {{p|Yveltal}}'s rampage from the outskirts of Vaniville Town. None of Liepard's moves are known.}} {{anchor|Bisharp 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Bryony |pkmn=Bisharp |type1=Dark |type2=Steel |gender=female |img=Bryony Bisharp Adventures.png |img_size=170px |epnum=PS578 |epname=Gyarados Changes |desc={{p|Bisharp}} is Bryony's second known Pokémon. She was used to try and stop the Kalos Gym Leaders from interfering with the [[ultimate weapon]]. Later, she was used to battle {{adv|Trevor}} near the [[Pokémon Village]] and easily took out Trevor's {{p|Flabébé}} before being knocked out by {{adv|X}}'s [[Salamè]]. She was later used to fight Trevor again, but was defeated once more by a combination attack made by Trevor's {{p|Floette}} and {{adv|Y}}'s [[Croaky]].
